Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant leukocyturia, proteinuria, hematuria, nitrites, bacteria, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Low specific gravity may indicate dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
